data.one_liner: Mediation adapter for DT Exchange via Google Mobile Ads
data.what_it_does: Provides a plugin that lets the google_mobile_ads Flutter plugin send ad requests to the DT Exchange ad network. It bridges the Dart layer with platform-specific adapters.
use_when: Using google_mobile_ads and need to serve ads from DT Exchange
Building a Flutter app that requires mediation with DT Exchange
avoid_when: Not targeting DT Exchange as a mediation partner
strengths: Supports latest DT Exchange Android and iOS adapters
Built and tested with Google Mobile Ads Flutter Plugin 9.1.0
weaknesses: Only works with DT Exchange, not other networks
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml; no build_runner or native permissions needed
